scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @skillevalator/web" "npm run dev -w @skillevalator/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @skillevalator/core && npm run build -w @skillevalator/web && npm run build -w @skillevalator/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w @skillevalator/core && npm run test -w @skillevalator/web && npm run test -w @skillevalator/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @skillevalator/core && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.smoke:export: npm run build -w @skillevalator/core && npm run test -w @skillevalator/web -- src/lib/officialExport.smoke.test.ts
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run smoke:skills && npm run smoke:paired && npm run smoke:official && npm run smoke:export
scripts.docker:check: docker info >nul 2>&1 && echo Docker OK || (echo Docker not available && exit 1)
